report_name: Administrator of 'Rydox' Cybercrime Market Pleads Guilty in U.S.

threat_actors.name: Ardit Kutleshi
threat_actors.description: The creator and primary operator of the Rydox cybercrime marketplace. A Kosovar national, he pleaded guilty in a U.S. federal court to charges of aggravated identity theft and conspiracy to commit money laundering.

threat_actors.name: Jetmir Kutleshi
threat_actors.description: The brother of Ardit Kutleshi and a co-operator of the Rydox marketplace. He had previously pleaded guilty and was sentenced.

threat_actors.name: Rydox
threat_actors.description: A cybercrime marketplace and criminal operation run by Ardit and Jetmir Kutleshi from 2016 until its takedown. It served as a hub for criminals to buy and sell stolen PII, credit card details, and hacking tools, using cryptocurrencies to obscure transactions.
threat_actors.goals: To generate revenue by facilitating the sale of stolen data and malicious tools, enabling fraud and identity theft.

attack_patterns.name: Acquire Infrastructure
attack_patterns.description: The operators of the Rydox marketplace acquired infrastructure, including the Rydox.cc domain and servers in Malaysia, to host their illicit online platform.

identities.name: U.S. Citizens
identities.description: The primary group of victims whose personal and financial data was trafficked on the Rydox marketplace.

infrastructure.name: Rydox Marketplace
infrastructure.description: An illicit online marketplace that operated on the domain Rydox.cc with servers in Malaysia. It was used by cybercriminals to buy and sell stolen personally identifiable information (PII), credit card details, and malicious hacking tools.
